name: Chika
source:
Chika is one of the identical twin "EXTRA" androids which were created by [url=/c12761]Ellen[/url]. Both she and and her sister [url=/c12769]Chito[/url] do not have any human feelings, they are designed to be used only as cold-blooded weapons. The two of them were created from [url=/c12764]Atsuko[/url]'s genes.

It seems that the only difference between the twins is their hairstyles. While Chika has two braids, Chito has only one.
